frontmatter.title: Why AI Pricing Is Hard: Designing Fair and Scalable Pricing Models for AI Applications
frontmatter.subheading: Cost unpredictability, model inference, and value-based pricing in real-world AI systems
frontmatter.excerpt: AI pricing is fundamentally different from SaaS. Learn why inference costs, scaling dynamics, and perceived value make AI application pricing hard-and how modern teams approach it.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
